vars.STYLE: Art style: hand-painted anime feature film look. Semi-realistic and painterly, watercolour-and-gouache rendering with soft visible brush texture, delicate thin ink lines, realistic proportions, natural facial features with gentle anime stylisation, soft natural lighting with gentle form shading, muted desaturated natural colour grading, subtle film grain. Refined; not chibi, not cartoonish, not photographic, no oversaturation. No text labels, no captions, no watermark.
vars.LAYOUT: Layout on a plain light grey background: four full-body views in a row on top (front, three-quarter, side profile, back) and four head close-ups below showing the listed expressions. Consistent proportions across all views.
vars.AGE_WEI: This is a character reference sheet of Wei, a Chinese (Hakka) man. Create the SAME sheet layout in the same art style, showing the SAME PERSON at a different age. He must be instantly recognisable as the same person. KEEP UNCHANGED: his Chinese (East Asian) ethnicity and facial features; the narrow face with slightly pointed chin; the exact eye shape and dark brown eyes; nose and mouth shape; the single small dark mole just below his RIGHT eye (on the viewer's left in front views), never on the other cheek; the art style, line quality and muted colours.
vars.AGE_SMRITI: This is a character reference sheet of Smriti, an Indo-Mauritian woman. Create the SAME sheet layout in the same art style, showing the SAME PERSON at a different age. She must be instantly recognisable as the same person. KEEP UNCHANGED: her Indo-Mauritian ethnicity and facial features; warm brown skin; large dark expressive eyes; thick dark eyebrows; a small neat gap between her two upper front teeth when she smiles (a diastema: ALL teeth present and healthy, nothing missing); her face shape; the art style, line quality and muted colours. No religious symbols or marks.
vars.STYLE_REF: STYLE REFERENCE: the attached image is a character sheet that defines the target art style. Create a NEW and DIFFERENT character (do not copy the boy) drawn in EXACTLY the same art style: the same rendering, line quality, colour palette, level of realism, facial stylisation and proportions. Same sheet layout: four full-body views in a row on top (front, three-quarter, side profile, back) and four head close-ups below.
